QuestInfo.0: #b#p3001106##k is looking for someone to handle a commission.
QuestInfo.1: #p3001106# gives you a merchant crew commission. You are to recover an item that the merchant crew lost. Apparently, this commission is categorized as a merchant crew commission and not a personal one because the item is shared by the merchant crew. Whatever the case may be, #b#t4033569##k items can be obtained from #rmonsters in the entire Heliseum region#k.
